serviceSummary: Official Guangxi Tianditu public layer registry exposed a province-wide 宗地 (parcel) ArcGIS MapServer. Its layer metadata reported polygon geometry and WKID 4490; a bounded anonymous POST query at the exact WUP point returned one polygon with safe native ZDID 240565597900398104. No owner, address, titleholder, tax, account, contact, or personal fields were requested.
queryOutcomes: English and Chinese first-party discovery queries were performed and recorded in the city record. The local Laibin bureau GET timed out. The Guangxi viewer shell, public layer registry, MapServer metadata, parcel-layer metadata, and POST query were successful. Encoded GET query attempts returned empty server replies; equivalent POST succeeded. No login, credentials, private token, CAPTCHA/Cloudflare bypass, or TLS disablement was used.
